status: Retrospective sensitivity. Candidate-specific guard and outer outcomes and earlier nomination rules on these same folds were available before this design. No new cohorts, tolerances, candidates, or outcome-dependent tuning.
question: Does replacing coordinatewise training medians by joint empirical-background averaging change which half-width deletion receives the single real guard refit?
background_reference: Covert, Lundberg and Lee (NeurIPS 2020), https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper/2020/hash/c7bf0b7c1a86d5eb3be2c722cf2cf746-Abstract.html . We use marginal integration as one missing-feature convention and calculate no Shapley values.
population: Keep the locked XGBoost initial model, Gain anchor and sorted half-width candidate slates, 30 first-panel folds and 16 wide-panel folds, all 216 non-anchor candidates. Retain all singleton anchors as zero-savings no-action folds. Hold the original proposal sample and four panel weights fixed.
intervention: For each fitted fold draw 16 training rows uniformly without replacement using NumPy default_rng SeedSequence([51731, panel_index, source_uci_id, fold, replicate_index]), panel_index=0 first or 1 wide, replicate_index=0 A or 1 B. Reuse the same donors for every masked set, every proposal row and matching masked anchor in that replicate. Copy all unobserved coordinates jointly from one donor. For each proposal row average its 16 predicted class-probability vectors with equal weights before computing any metric. The model and proposal are transformed using the original fit-partition medians for missing observations. Donor replicates A and B use independent streams. Report both without selecting the better set.
nomination: Use the archived metric-normalized point score (original panel, empty restoration) and continuous minimum over the same separating restorations (third-largest of four weighted panel margins; minimum across metrics and contexts). Match the archived deterministic candidate order for ties. Preserve rare-positive AP activation. Compute proposals once per receiver-independent voter. Seal all candidate scores, winners, cost counts and donor IDs before joining existing outcomes.
outcomes: For XGBoost and C=1 logistic receivers independently, use each fixed nominee's archived real guard and outer refit. Same relative AUC and accuracy tolerance .03 and active AP .05, slack 1e-12, fallback to receiver anchor. Compare donor-point and donor-full with corresponding archived median rule and exact uniform over the same slate. Report equal task-in-panel average U and breach, accuracy and AUC; descriptive paired 30000 task bootstrap (seed 33119) for primary U and breach. Stratify by receiver and panel. Report donor-replicate nomination agreement on actionable folds, distinct support evaluations, model rows and elapsed wall time per stage. Clocks are local descriptive costs. This is a sensitivity check on a fixed pool, not an independent confirmation.
runtime: Single-threaded classifier and bounded inference batches, no more than 32 MiB of masked feature inputs per batch. Stop a fold if either background pass exceeds 45 minutes at a mask boundary; report any incomplete fold explicitly without replacing it or dropping it from an estimate.
